tool_args.rationale: The observations combine sink inhibition with a long-horizon sign reversal. This tests two numerically fitted timescales with several ways for the sink to couple to the transient response, selecting among them by training residual; fresh confirmation is needed to assess generalization.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Both were refuted on fresh confirmation; the second also had training RMSE above tolerance.
It does not account for the observed variation with sink gradient.
Eleven observations now span short, intermediate and long horizons; first test a revised stationary mechanism against them.
